meta.name: Península OC — Editorial Clinical
meta.description: Rev 3 (2026-10-27): rebuilt from research of studio-built clinic sites (Neko Health, Parsley Health, Superpower, Schulthess Klinik, Fortius Clinic) on top of the owner's valenzuelayaguilar.com taste.

color.palette_type: monochromatic with a single cool accent

primary.role: clinical blue — filled buttons, hover fills, selection, small accents

secondary.role: tint — cool alternate section surface; must read as clearly different from paper (old #F3F4F5 merged with white)

accent.role: brand teal — italic headline word on dark photos, sparing highlights (reference role: gold #c9a86c)

neutral.usage: paper, mist tint (alternate light surface), hairlines, muted text, body text, ink headings

surface.card: white tile on tint, or translucent tile on navy; 4px radius, no shadow

color.contrast_strategy: light site: sections alternate paper #FFFFFF / mist #E6EDF4. Navy #0A1628 is used ONLY as the footer surface (and as ink text). Home hero is the only dark photo area.

font_families.heading: Newsreader (h1–h3, figures, quotes only)
font_families.body: Hanken Grotesk 400/500 (body, nav, buttons, labels, lists)

typography.font_style_notes: Serif display + neutral grotesk, as on Neko/Parsley. No italics. Emphasis = weight/tone contrast. Sentence case everywhere, including data. Body 16px; nothing under 13px.

spacing.section_rhythm: 64px mobile / 80–96px desktop; surfaces alternate (home: photo → paper strip → navy → paper → tint → navy footer)

layout.alignment_tendency: mixed — centered statements, left-aligned content grids

shape.border_usage: 1px hairlines; tiles use a 1px border only on navy
shape.divider_style: 1px #E3E6EA rules on top of list items and between columns; thin vertical bars between inline items

elevation.depth_cues: full-bleed photography and color blocks, never drop shadows

iconography.style: No arrows, chevrons or content icons anywhere (user rule: arrows read as generic). Only functional glyphs: phone, mail, WhatsApp, menu.
iconography.preferred_set: inline SVG for those four glyphs only

motion.easing: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1) everywhere (REVEAL.ease in useReveal.js = --ease-out-soft in index.css)

duration_scale.macro: 1100ms headline line masks, 1.8s hero photo entrance

motion.entrance_pattern: One recipe: opacity 0→1 + translateY(16px)→0, 800ms, plays ONCE (useInViewOnce). Lists stagger 60ms per item. Headlines rise from an overflow mask (1100ms).
motion.exit_pattern: none — revealed content never hides again

components.button_style: 48px, 4px radius, 15px Hanken Grotesk 500; primary = clinical blue fill, outline = ink hairline that fills blue on hover, white on photos. Never navy fills.
components.input_style: 48px tall, 1px hairline border, 4px radius, white fill, ink border on focus
components.card_style: No boxed cards. Doctors: identical portrait cards (photo, serif name, sans specialty, hairline credential rows, 'Ver perfil →'). Services: index rows (serif name · conditions · circular arrow).
components.navigation_pattern: transparent fixed header over hero turning white on scroll; logo / centered links / phone
components.list_style: hairline rows; whole row is the link, name turns clinical blue and its 'Consultar' line draws on hover
components.component_notes: Navigation cues are typographic: `.link-line` — a 28% hairline under a 500-weight label that the clinical blue draws across on hover (0.6s ease-out-soft). Used for 'Consultar', 'Ver perfil', 'Anterior / Siguiente', 'Volver al equipo'.

visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: heavy photography in hero/bands, light typographic sections between
visual_language.contrast_level: high on text, low on surfaces

composition.hierarchy_method: scale and weight/tone contrast within one serif family (never italics)
composition.grouping_strategy: alternating surfaces between sections; hairlines and flat tiles within

imagery.photo_treatment: saturate(.7–.8) brightness(.85), dark gradient for legibility

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: underline to full opacity, slow 1.03 image zoom, button fill swap

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: warm, direct, factual — every claim traceable to doctors.js (no 'avales', no unsupported numbers)

scroll_morphing.description: Curtain hero (as on valenzuelayaguilar.com): hero is position:sticky with top:min(0px, 100svh - var(--curtain-h)); every following section is position:relative z-index:1 with its own solid background and slides up over it. ResizeObserver sets --curtain-h. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

text_effects.description: each headline line translates up from 106% inside overflow:hidden

params.effect_style: clean; highlight line is heavier weight, not italic

image_effects.description: desaturated photos; hover zoom to 1.03 over 900ms

visual_effects.composite_notes: Premium feel comes from restraint: one serif, no shadows, no pills, no italics, no decorative icons. One bold moment per page (home: navy body-area tiles that invert on hover).
